summary.en: A modern web edition of the Royal Game of Ur — one of the oldest board games known — with online play.
summary.zh: 人类最古老的棋盘游戏之一（乌尔王室棋）的现代网页版，支持线上对战。

description.en: Roll the dice to set your move, race your pieces along the path, and land on a rival piece to send it back to the start. Get all of yours home first to win.
description.zh: 掷骰决定步数，棋子沿棋盘路径前进，踩到对方棋子可将其送回起点，全部棋子走完终点即胜。

howto.en: Mouse — click to roll and to move.

tip.en: Niche gameplay but rich in history — a great anchor for an 'ancient games of the world' series. It already ships online rooms, so the matchmaking layer can be reused in your own lobby.
tip.zh: 玩法小众但历史感强，适合做「世界古棋」系列内容。已带线上房间功能，可直接复用到自己的联机大厅。
